questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) (i) What is cloud computing? (2 marks)

(ii) Describe any two (02) basic requirements of cloud computing. (4 marks)

(iii) Explain any two advantages of cloud computing. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Cloud computing (2 marks).** Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services (data storage, servers, software, databases, processing power) over the Internet ("the cloud") from the remote data centres of a service provider. The user rents the services on demand, usually paying only for what is used, instead of buying and maintaining his own equipment.

**(ii) Two basic requirements (4 marks: 1 mark to state + 1 mark to describe, for each)**

Any two of the following:

- **A reliable Internet connection** with enough bandwidth: the services are reached through the Internet, so without a connection the user cannot reach his data and applications.
- **A client device with a web browser or an app** (computer, tablet, smartphone): it is used to log in to the cloud and to use the services.
- **An account or subscription with a cloud service provider:** the provider gives the user a login and the amount of storage or service that he has paid for.
- **Servers and data centres of the provider** (with virtualisation software): they supply the storage space and the processing power.

**(iii) Two advantages (2 marks, 1 mark each)**

- **Lower cost:** no need to buy, install and maintain expensive servers and software; the user pays only for what he uses.
- **Access from anywhere and at any time**, on any device connected to the Internet, which allows people to work together on the same files.
- Other accepted advantages: easy increase or decrease of storage (scalability), automatic backup and updates.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(b) Briefly describe each of the following file protection mechanism,

(i) Backup (2 marks)

(ii) Data encryption (2 marks)

(iii) Archiving (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Backup (2 marks).** Making a copy of files and data and keeping it in a different place (external disk, another computer, the cloud) so that the data can be restored if the original is lost, damaged, deleted, stolen or attacked by a virus.

**(ii) Data encryption (2 marks).** Converting data (plain text) into an unreadable form (cipher text) using an algorithm and a secret key. Only a person who has the correct key can decrypt the data and read it, so the data stays confidential if it is stolen or intercepted.

**(iii) Archiving (2 marks).** Moving data that is old and no longer in daily use, but that must be kept (for legal or historical reasons), to a separate long-term storage (often compressed), so that it is kept safe and can be retrieved later, while the space and the speed of the main system are preserved.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(c) A project team consisting of persons living in different localities, decides to hold an online meeting. During the meeting each person is to do a presentation of work progress.

(i) State a technology that will enable the team members to hold a successful meeting. (1 mark)

(ii) State and explain the roles of any two tools that will enable each team member to participate effectively in the meeting. (4 marks)

(iii) Describe any one advantage of using the technology or means you stated in c(i) above to the participants. (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Technology (1 mark).** Video conferencing (web conferencing) over the Internet, using a meeting application.

**(ii) Two tools and their roles (4 marks: 1 mark to state and 1 mark to explain, for each tool)**

Any two of the following:

- **Webcam:** captures the video of the member who is speaking, so that the others can see him.
- **Microphone:** captures the voice of the member so that the others can hear his presentation.
- **Headset or loudspeakers:** let the member hear the other participants.
- **Screen-sharing (presentation) feature:** lets the member show his slides or documents to everybody while he presents.
- **Chat box:** lets participants ask questions or send messages and files during the meeting.

**(iii) One advantage (1 mark).** The members do not need to travel to one place: this saves time and travel money, and everybody can attend and follow the presentations in real time from where he is.
